theorems.name: Submission.iwl_cr_support_lemmas
theorems.statement: (∀ (P m : ℕ) (U : Set (Eucl P)) (Z : GeometricCurrentOn U (m + 1)), Z.boundary.support ⊆ Z.support) ∧ (∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Eucl P)), IsOpen U → ∀ (K : Set (Eucl P)) (Zj : ℕ → GeometricCurrentOn U n) (Z : GeometricCurrentOn U n), IsClosed K → (∀ j, (Zj j).support ⊆ K) → WeaklyConvergesOn Zj Z → Z.support ⊆ K) ∧ (∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Eucl P)), IsOpen U → ∀ (Z₁ Z₂ Z : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (a b : ℝ), (∀ ω : TestFormOn U n, Z ω = a * Z₁ ω + b * Z₂ ω) → Z.support ⊆ Z₁.support ∪ Z₂.support)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
